name: Shining Cursor Trail
author: Taisa - Raquel García Arévalo

sections.description:
Shining Cursor Trail adds a magical sparkling effect to your cursor, creating a more engaging experience for your visitors.
You can customize color and icon to match your site’s style.
sections.installation:
1. Upload shining-cursor-trail folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Shining Cursor Trail to customize.
sections.faq:
Can I change the sparkle icon?

Yes! You can modify the sparkle character and color from the settings panel.

Will this affect my website’s performance?

No, the plugin is optimized to be lightweight and efficient.
